import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'amount': [115.02, 44.37, 144.25, 536.22, 38.43],
    'is_fraud': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'transaction_type': ['refund', 'payment', 'transfer', 'payment', 'payment'],
    'hour_of_day': [22, 5, 21, 17, 5]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 10))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))

# 1. Transaction amount distribution
axes[0, 0].bar(range(len(df)), df['amount'], color='skyblue', edgecolor='black')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Transaction Amounts', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Transaction Index', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)
for i, v in enumerate(df['amount']):
    axes[0, 0].text(i, v + 5, f'${v:.2f}', ha='center', fontsize=10)

# 2. Transaction types distribution
type_counts = df['transaction_type'].value_counts()
colors = ['lightcoral', 'lightgreen', 'lightblue']
axes[0, 1].pie(type_counts.values, labels=type_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
               colors=colors[:len(type_counts)], startangle=90)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Transaction Type Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Hour of day distribution
hour_counts = df['hour_of_day'].value_counts().sort_index()
axes[1, 0].bar(hour_counts.index, hour_counts.values, color='mediumpurple', edgecolor='black')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Transactions by Hour of Day', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))
for i, v in enumerate(hour_counts.values):
    axes[1, 0].text(hour_counts.index[i], v + 0.1, str(v), ha='center', fontsize=10)

# 4. Fraud status (all non-fraud in this dataset)
fraud_counts = df['is_fraud'].value_counts()
fraud_labels = ['Non-Fraud' if x == 0 else 'Fraud' for x in fraud_counts.index]
axes[1, 1].bar(fraud_labels, fraud_counts.values, color=['lightgreen', 'lightcoral'], edgecolor='black')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Fraud Status Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=12)
for i, v in enumerate(fraud_counts.values):
    axes[1, 1].text(i, v + 0.1, str(v), ha='center', fontsize=10)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
